subject: Re: Error: Aesthetics must either be length one, or the same length as the data

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Error: Aesthetics must either be length one, or the same length as the data
parts:
Is wt a vector?  If it is independent from your x dataframe this might be the issue. Can you cbind the two together and see if you get the error?

It is probably looking for x$wt and not finding it.
length(x$wt)

B

On Saturday, August 4, 2012, rms wrote:
I have just upgraded ggplot2 and have started getting the error above on a line of code that has executed without error in the past.  I found a few related posts in the archive, but was unable to find one that worked for this case.  Has anyone seen this before?

Thank you.

> plotmatrix(x[,16:21]) + aes(size=wt)
Error: Aesthetics must either be length one, or the same length as the dataProblems:wt
>
> nrow(x[,16:21])
[1] 64
> length(wt)
[1] 64

messages.subject: Re: Error: Aesthetics must either be length one, or the same length as the data
parts:
Thank you for this tip, Brandon.  Unfortunately, I tried your suggestion but got the same result.

wt is a numeric vector and x is a data frame with cols 16:21 numeric. There are no missing values in either.

This seems to be some sort of library or configuration issue since the following executes:

> y<-data.frame(cbind(a=runif(100),b=runif(1000),c=runif(100)))
> plotmatrix(y) 

but this throws up the error::

> plotmatrix(y)+aes(size=runif(100))

Thank you.
